classes.title: Boxing
classes.blurb: Shadow boxing combos to a 120 bpm beat. Punches are counted, and Reta checks your guard.

warm.name: March and arm circles
warm.how: March on the spot and circle your arms forwards, then backwards.

warm.name: Step-touch and shoulder rolls
warm.how: Step side to side and roll your shoulders back.

warm.name: Slow bob and weave
warm.how: Small squat as you dip your head side to side under an imaginary rope.
cues: Bend the knees, not the back

warm.name: Easy jabs
warm.how: Guard up: fists by your cheeks, elbows in, soft knees, one foot slightly forward. Gentle jabs with the lead hand.
cues: Snap it out, snap it back

warm.name: Torso twists in guard
warm.how: Hold your guard and rotate gently from the waist.

main.name: Jab-cross ×8
main.how: Guard up: fists by your cheeks, elbows in, soft knees, one foot slightly forward. Jab (front hand), cross (back hand). 8 then reset.
cues: Rotate the back hip on the cross

main.name: Jab-cross ×8, then hooks
main.how: Eight jab-crosses, then hooks: elbow up at shoulder height, swing round, pivot.

main.name: Speed jabs (low impact)
main.how: Quick light jabs, small bounce or just soft knees.

main.name: Hooks left and right
main.how: Left hook, right hook. Elbows up, pivot the feet.

main.name: Jab-cross-hook
main.how: Jab, cross, lead hook. Reset to guard.

main.name: Uppercuts
main.how: Dip slightly, drive up from the legs, palm facing you.
main.fix: Drive up from your hips, fist rising to chin height

main.name: Jab-cross-slip
main.how: Jab, cross, then slip: small dip of the head to one side.

main.name: Body jabs with a squat
main.how: Bend the knees and jab to body height, stand back up.
cues: Sit back like the chair is there

main.name: Uppercut-hook combo
main.how: Rear uppercut, lead hook, repeat.
main.fix: Drive up from your hips, fist rising to chin height

main.name: Speed punches
main.how: Fast straight punches, light hands, soft knees.

main.name: Jab-cross-hook-cross
main.how: The classic four-punch combo: 1-2-3-2.

main.name: Bob and weave + cross
main.how: Weave under the rope, come up with a cross.

main.name: Combo ladder
main.how: Build it up: 1-2, then 1-2-3, then 1-2-3-2.

main.name: Power round: jab-cross ×8 then hooks
main.how: Eight strong jab-crosses, then hooks until the bell.

main.name: Finisher: speed punches
main.how: Everything you have left, fast light punches.

cool.name: Slow march and breathe
cool.how: Slow march, big breath in, long breath out.

cool.name: Chest and shoulder stretch
cool.how: Hands behind you, gently open the chest.

cool.name: Triceps stretch
cool.how: One hand down your back, gently press the elbow. Swap at 30 seconds.

cool.name: Thigh stretch (hold the chair)
cool.how: Hold a chair, bring one heel to your bum. Swap at 30 seconds.

cool.name: Calf stretch and breathe
cool.how: Hands on the wall, one leg back, heel down. Swap at 30 seconds.

classes.title: Dance
classes.blurb: Low-impact dance cardio in 8-count blocks that build into two routines.

warm.name: Step-touch
warm.how: Step right, tap left; step left, tap right.

warm.name: Step-touch with arm swings
warm.how: Add a gentle arm swing across the body.
counts: Add arms: swing on every step

warm.name: Slow grapevine
warm.how: Step side, cross behind, step side, tap. Then back.

warm.name: Hip rolls and shoulder pops
warm.how: Feet wide, roll the hips, pop the shoulders on the beat.

warm.name: Knee lift and clap
warm.how: Lift a knee and clap under it, alternate.
counts: Knee on 1, clap; knee on 3, clap

main.name: Box step
main.how: Right foot forward, left forward, right back, left back.
counts: 1 forward R, 2 forward L, 3 back R, 4 back L

main.name: Box step + arms
main.how: Layer the arms: reach up on 1-2, down on 3-4.
counts: Add arms: up on 1-2, down on 3-4

main.name: Grapevine + clap
main.how: Grapevine right with a clap on 4, left with a clap on 8.

main.name: Routine A: box step + grapevine
main.how: Put them together: one 8 of box steps, one 8 of grapevines.

main.name: Hamstring curls + arms
main.how: Step out and curl the heel behind, pull the arms in.
counts: Add a row with the arms

main.name: Double step-touch
main.how: Two step-touches right, two left.

main.name: Routine A with arms
main.how: Routine A with all the arm layers.

main.name: Side step + body roll
main.how: Step out wide and roll through the body (small is fine).

main.name: Kick-ball-change (low)
main.how: Small kick forward, step back on the ball of the foot, change. No jumping.

main.name: Routine B layered
main.how: Side step + body roll, then kick-ball-change.

main.name: Low-impact pony step
main.how: Small side-to-side shuffle, no jumping.

main.name: Mambo step
main.how: Step forward, rock back, step together.

main.name: Routine B with arms
main.how: Routine B with arms reaching on every step.

main.name: Freestyle groove
main.how: Your move! Any step from today, stay on the beat.

main.name: Full routine A + B
main.how: Everything: routine A, then routine B, on repeat.

cool.name: Slow sway
cool.how: Slow side-to-side sway, let the arms float.

cool.name: Side stretch
cool.how: One arm up and over. Swap at 30 seconds.

cool.name: Hamstring stretch
cool.how: One heel forward, toes up, hinge from the hips.

cool.name: Thigh stretch (hold the chair)
cool.how: Heel to bum, holding a chair. Swap at 30 seconds.

cool.name: Breathe and shake out
cool.how: Big breaths, shake out the hands and legs.

classes.title: Latin Dance Cardio (Zumba-style)
classes.blurb: Merengue, salsa, cumbia and reggaeton-style steps. Low impact, 100–130 bpm. Not affiliated with Zumba®.

warm.name: Merengue march
warm.how: March on the spot, let the hips move naturally.

warm.name: Merengue + arms
warm.how: Add arm rolls and elbow pumps.

warm.name: Slow salsa basic
warm.how: Forward on 1, back to centre on 2-3; back on 5, centre on 6-7.

warm.name: Hip sways
warm.how: Feet wide, sway the hips side to side.

warm.name: Slow cumbia step
warm.how: Step back on a diagonal, return; other side.

main.name: Merengue
main.how: Marching merengue, add side steps.

main.name: Salsa basic
main.how: Forward-back salsa basic, add shoulders.

main.name: Salsa side + arms
main.how: Side salsa: right on 1, left on 5, arms open.

main.name: Cumbia
main.how: Cumbia step with a small turn of the shoulders.

main.name: Reggaeton step (low impact)
main.how: Bounce the knees, step side, tap.

main.name: Cha-cha side
main.how: Rock step, then cha-cha-cha to the side.

main.name: Combo: merengue + salsa
main.how: One 8 merengue, one 8 salsa basic.

main.name: Mambo
main.how: Mambo forward and back.

main.name: Samba-style bounce (low)
main.how: Small bounce through the knees, step-ball-change. No jumping.

main.name: Cumbia combo
main.how: Cumbia + side steps with arms.

main.name: Slow salsa turn
main.how: Easy walk-around turn in 4 steps, or just sway.

main.name: Merengue party
main.how: Merengue with big arms and hip sways.

main.name: Reggaeton combo
main.how: Step-taps with shoulder pops.

main.name: Freestyle fiesta
main.how: Any Latin step you like, stay with the beat.

main.name: Full combo
main.how: Merengue, salsa, cumbia: one 8 each.

cool.name: Slow sway
cool.how: Slow hip sway, long breaths.

cool.name: Arm and shoulder stretch
cool.how: Arm across the chest, then swap.

cool.name: Side stretch
cool.how: Reach up and over, swap at 30 seconds.

cool.name: Hamstring stretch
cool.how: Heel forward, hinge from the hips.

cool.name: Breathe
cool.how: Hands on your heart, slow breaths.

classes.title: Yoga
classes.blurb: Slow, beginner yoga with breath cues. Reta times your holds, and the timer only counts while you're in the pose.

warm.name: Breathing with arms
warm.how: Stand tall. Breathe in for 4 as the arms rise, out for 6 as they lower.

warm.name: Neck and shoulder rolls
warm.how: Gentle half-circles with the head, then roll the shoulders.

warm.name: Cat-cow (seated or all fours)
warm.how: Breathe in, lift the chest; breathe out, round the back.

warm.name: Standing side bend
warm.how: Arms up, lean gently to one side, then the other.

warm.name: Mountain pose
warm.how: Stand tall, feet hip-width, arms by your sides. Breathe.

main.name: Chair pose
main.how: Feet together or hip-width, sit back as if into a chair, arms up.
cues: Breathe out, sit a little lower

main.name: Warrior II (right)
main.how: Feet wide, right toes out, bend the right knee over the ankle, arms out at shoulder height.

main.name: Warrior II (left)
main.how: Same on the left side.

main.name: Tree pose (right, hold the chair)
main.how: Stand on the left leg, right foot on your ankle or calf (never the knee). Hold a chair if you like.

main.name: Tree pose (left)
main.how: Stand on the right leg, left foot on the ankle or calf.
cues: Find a spot to focus on

main.name: Chair pose flow
main.how: Inhale stand, exhale sit into chair pose. Hold the last one.

main.name: Downward dog (knees bent)
main.how: From all fours, tuck the toes and lift the hips. Keep the knees bent and heels up.

main.name: Cat-cow flow
main.how: On all fours: inhale, lift the chest; exhale, round the back.

main.name: Triangle (right, short)
main.how: Legs wide, reach forward over the right leg, hand to the shin or a chair, other arm up.

main.name: Triangle (left, short)
main.how: Other side.

main.name: Mountain flow with arms
main.how: Stand tall. Inhale, arms overhead; exhale, hands to heart.

main.name: Chair pose hold
main.how: One more chair pose. Hold and breathe.
cues: Sink a little lower if you can

main.name: Warrior II flow (both sides)
main.how: Warrior II right, straighten, warrior II left, with the breath.

main.name: Tree pose (right) again
main.how: Try lifting the arms if you feel steady.

main.name: Tree pose (left) again
main.how: Other side.

cool.name: Seated forward fold
cool.how: Sit, legs forward, hinge gently towards your toes.

cool.name: Gentle cat-cow
cool.how: On all fours, slow cat-cow with long breaths.

cool.name: Supine twist
cool.how: On your back, knees bent, let them drop to one side, then the other.
cool.fix: Keep knees bent together and let them drop slowly side to side

cool.name: Child's pose
cool.how: Knees wide, sit back to your heels, arms forward.

cool.name: Relaxation
cool.how: Lie or sit comfortably. Close your eyes. Breathe.

classes.title: Pilates
classes.blurb: Controlled mat Pilates on a towel or carpet: bridges, leg lifts, clams, bird dog and knee planks. Reps are counted.

warm.name: Breathing and pelvic tilts
warm.how: Lie on your back, knees bent. Gently tilt the pelvis with the breath. Keep your hips on the floor.
warm.fix: Hips stay on the floor, just flatten and arch your lower back

warm.name: Small bridges
warm.how: Peel the hips up a little, then down. Slow.

warm.name: The hundred (knees bent, gentle)
warm.how: On your back, feet on the floor, pump the arms low. Breathe in for 5 pumps, out for 5. Head down is fine.

warm.name: Spine stretch forward
warm.how: Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward as you breathe out, roll up as you breathe in.

warm.name: Single leg stretch (beginner)
warm.how: On your back, hug one knee in while the other leg reaches long. Swap slowly. Head down is fine.

main.name: Glute bridge
main.how: Feet flat, squeeze and lift the hips, lower slowly.
cues: Lower one bone at a time

main.name: Side-lying leg lift (right)
main.how: Lie on your left side, lift the top leg slowly, lower with control.

main.name: Side-lying leg lift (left)
main.how: Other side.

main.name: Clams (right)
main.how: Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together, open the top knee.
main.fix: Keep your feet together, just open the top knee

main.name: Clams (left)
main.how: Other side.
main.fix: Keep your feet together, just open the top knee

main.name: Bird dog
main.how: On all fours, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, return, swap.

main.name: Knee plank
main.how: Forearms down, knees down, straight line from head to knees.

main.name: Bridge with a hold
main.how: Lift, hold for 2, lower slowly.

main.name: Leg lift (right) round 2
main.how: Smaller and slower than before.

main.name: Leg lift (left) round 2
main.how: Other side.

main.name: Bird dog round 2
main.how: Pause for a breath at full reach.

main.name: Knee plank round 2
main.how: Head to knees in one line.

main.name: Clams (right) round 2
main.how: Pause at the top.
main.fix: Keep your feet together, just open the top knee

main.name: Clams (left) round 2
main.how: Other side.
main.fix: Keep your feet together, just open the top knee

main.name: Bridge pulses
main.how: Lift, then small pulses at the top, lower slowly.

cool.name: Spine stretch forward
cool.how: Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward slowly and breathe.

cool.name: Lying spine twist
cool.how: On your back, knees to one side, then the other.

cool.name: Hamstring stretch
cool.how: On your back, one leg up, hold behind the thigh.

cool.name: Figure-4 stretch
cool.how: Ankle on the opposite knee, gently draw in. Swap at 30 seconds.

cool.name: Breathe
cool.how: Long slow breaths. Well done.
